boundary_atlas.equal_frequency: omega_plus=omega_minus is the ordinary harmonic oscillator; the Wronskian zeros recover lambda_n=omega*(n+1/2)
boundary_atlas.free: both frequencies zero give the free particle, all p=0 states are equilibria, and nonzero momentum is unbounded
boundary_atlas.one_sided_zero: a flat half-axis is a continuum of rest equilibria and every other orbit reaching it escapes linearly; quantum compact resolvent is lost and essential spectrum begins at zero
boundary_atlas.seam: the force is continuous and globally Lipschitz, while its derivative jumps unless the frequencies agree
boundary_atlas.smoothness: the action-angle map is not claimed globally C-infinity across the seam
boundary_atlas.zero_energy: for positive frequencies E=0 is only the origin equilibrium

collision_boundary.C212: affine impact dynamics resets velocity and has a separate flight-time roof
collision_boundary.C232: Duffing is smooth, amplitude-dependent, and has separatrix chambers
collision_boundary.C238: Coulomb friction is dissipative Filippov dynamics with finite capture
collision_boundary.C252: the relay oscillator changes a discrete guard state and owns an attracting hybrid cycle

model.action_angle_regularness: globally C1 and piecewise analytic on the punctured plane, but not C2 across the seam unless the frequencies agree
model.classical_equation: x_dot=p; p_dot=-omega_plus^2*x for x>=0 and -omega_minus^2*x for x<=0
model.quantum_operator: -one_half*d2_dx2+V on L2(R), defined by its Friedrichs quadratic form

nonclaims: No priority claim is made for asymmetric parabolic isochrony or parabolic-cylinder matching.
Classical isochrony does not imply an equally spaced asymmetric quantum spectrum.
The interface Wronskian is a source spectral equation, not a target determinant.
No target arithmetic datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, target divisor, functional equation, target-zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route-B input is claimed.

references.role: primary study of quantum spectra of isochronous potentials including the asymmetric parabolic well
NIST authority for the parabolic-cylinder equation, values, derivatives, and Wronskians

theorem_contract.action_angle: the punctured plane has a global C1 piecewise-analytic action-angle chart with dx wedge dp=dtheta wedge dJ and theta_dot=Omega; it is not C2 across the seam unless the frequencies agree
theorem_contract.boundaries: equal frequency, zero energy, one-sided zero stiffness, and the free particle are stated separately
theorem_contract.classical_iff: all nonzero trajectories are bounded periodic with a common least period iff omega_plus and omega_minus are both positive
theorem_contract.quantum: for positive frequencies the Friedrichs operator is self-adjoint with compact resolvent and simple spectrum, and lambda is an eigenvalue iff the parabolic-cylinder interface Wronskian vanishes
theorem_contract.seam_monodromy: the two seam-to-seam half-flow matrices are minus identity, so the common-period map and its derivative are identity

zero_stiffness_rows.classical: rest continuum on x>=0 plus linear escape
rest continuum on x<=0 plus linear escape
